question.text: Total number of elements which are present in a row on the periodic table between those elements, whose wavelength of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></msub></math> lines are equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>179</mn><mo> </mo><mi>pm</mi></math> are (Rydberg constant = <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>097</mn><mo> </mo><mo>×</mo><mo> </mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>7</mn></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>)

solution.text:
Wavelength of Kα line is given by

λ=43RZ-12

For λ, between 250 and 179 pm three elements are possible
( Z = 24, 25 and 26 ).
